latest_release.name: v4.6.2
latest_release.body:
# Essential Links

* [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/chart.js)
* [Migration guide](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/4.6.2/migration/v4-migration.html)
* [Docs](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/4.6.2/)
* [API](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/4.6.2/api/)
* [Samples](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/4.6.2/samples/information.html)

## Bugs Fixed

- #12411 fix: skip missing active elements when setting hover
- #12414 fix: apply category bounds after inferring labels
- #12421 fix: let responsive charts grow back in containers sized by their content
- #12426 fix: zero tick format bounds, plus docs and tests for the 4.6.2 scale and legend fixes
- #12415 fix: exclude explicit scale bounds from grace
- #12379 fix: align inner tick labels inwards on reversed linear axes
- #12352 fix: do not throw when ticks.format sets only one fraction digits bound
- #12348 fix(legend): call onLeave on mouseout over a legend item
- #12339 Fix width calculation for multiline vertical legend labels
- #12323 Fix resize update mode being an array when resizeDelay is set
- #12292 fix legend line point style not showing the dataset dash
- #12282 Fix floating point drift in generated linear scale ticks
- #12289 fix(scale): make time getValueForPixel the inverse of getPixelForValue
- #12302 fix: apply number format options to zero ticks
- #12420 fix(tooltip): tolerate a missing dataset controller on events outside chartArea
- #12419 fix: update before drawing when a resize arrives before the first update
- #12194 fix: handle splice with single argument
- #12286 fix(helpers): resolveObjectKey returns wrong value for Object.prototype keys

## Types

- #12264 fix(types): allow skipNull on bar datasets

## Documentation

- #12404 docs: describe multiple axes with the scales option instead of xAxes/yAxes
- #12393 docs: fix tooltip titleSpacing, bodySpacing and footerSpacing descriptions
- #12377 docs(elements): document point and bar hover color options
- #12338 docs: fix broken in-page anchors
- #12278 docs: note lineTension rename to tension in v3 migration guide
- #12410 Clarify chart-specific legend overrides
- #12228 Minor bug fix in usage.md example code
- #12394 docs: remove duplicated word in doughnut spacing JSDoc

## Development

- #12433 chore: version bump to 4.6.2 to prepare for release
- #12424 docs: design the migration of the docs site from VuePress to VitePress
- #12423 docs: design the migration of the test suite from Karma to Vitest
- #12402 add oklch colors by updating to @<!---->kurkle/color 0.6
- #12270 Add regression test for enter animation with fractional container width
- #12417 chore: remove unused coveralls dev dependency
- #12408 chore: upgrade rollup to v4 and karma/jasmine dependencies
- #12407 Upgrade to pnpm 12 and node lts 26

Thanks to @Aurantium-47, @Hashim1999164, @HuzaifaChaudary, @MarkAStevens04, @Ph0tonic, @SatvikMishra08, @SrkianFardin25, @UlikGames, @adityajai119, @azizu06, @contactjawad, @dieterstemmet, @etimberg, @farisbasha, @kerdofficial, @kurkle, @kwy404, @ninglinLiu, @pei711, @pentaoa, @puneetdixit200, @spokodev, @veeceey, @wozhenbang2004 and @zizhao-hu

detail.readme:
Simple yet flexible JavaScript charting for designers & developers

## Documentation All the links point to the new version 4 of the lib. * [Introduction](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/) * [Getting Started](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/getting-started/index) * [General](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/general/data-structures) * [Configuration](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/configuration/index) * [Charts](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/charts/line) * [Axes](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/axes/index) * [Developers](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/latest/developers/index) * [Popular Extensions](https://github.com/chartjs/awesome) * [Samples](https://www.chartjs.org/samples/) In case you are looking for an older version of the docs, you will have to specify the specific version in the url like this: [https://www.chartjs.org/docs/2.9.4/](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/2.9.4/) ## Contributing Instructions on building and testing Chart.js can be found in [the documentation](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/master/developers/contributing.html#building-and-testing). Before submitting an issue or a pull request, please take a moment to look over the [contributing guidelines](https://www.chartjs.org/docs/master/developers/contributing) first. For support, please post questions on [Stack Overflow](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/chart.js) with the `chart.js` tag. ## License Chart.js is available under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).
